description:
Problem and verified history
The current lib/zaq/channels/delivery/attachments.ex retains prepare/3 -> prepare_all -> prepare_next alongside production prepare_execution/3. Repository production callers use prepare_execution; prepare/3 callers found were tests.
04de24a4c introduced DeliveryFiles.with_prepared/4. df593045a (2026-11-04) replaced it with public prepare/3 used by Jido/Email. d531d4e84 added policy handling. 14fee186e retained prepare/3 as a production call inside plan_files/4. b176f8ca7 (2026-11-19) moved materialization into execution and removed that caller, but copied the old API/helpers into DeliveryAttachments. db336f6e9 moved them into Delivery.Attachments. These are feature-branch changes, not an API inherited from current origin/main.

Implementation
Verify aliases, dynamic callers, supported external consumers, and current tests before deletion. Remove the superseded prepare/3 API (including default-generated arity), prepare_all, prepare_next, and obsolete types/docs only where unused. Keep prepare_record/2, acquisition, metadata validation, decoding, trusted-context normalization and other primitives used by execution. Do not make execution call the old bulk-policy API. Preserve planned membership, stable original indices, acquire-once behavior, actual-byte limits, abort/continue semantics, and metadata-only planning.

Action reuse: retain shared preparation/materialization primitives and production prepare_execution; remove the second bulk-policy owner.

Tests
Inventory delivery/attachments_test.exs, attachment_policy_test.exs and jido_chat_delivery_test.exs. Delete tests whose only contract is the retired prepare API/result shapes. Move still-relevant authorization, revocation, malformed/base64/raw byte, source-preservation, ordering, failure-policy and encoding properties to production preparation/execution boundaries before removing their old tests. Remove obsolete fixtures/stubs and stale references. Include a deletion-to-retained-coverage mapping in completion notes. Existing test-entry-point migration and obsolete test deletion are explicitly approved in this issue; preserving live behavior is required.

Authorization and boundaries
User explicitly requested these four cleanup issues on 2026-11-20 and approved removing tests related to this cleanup. Remove tests/fixtures that exist solely for retired APIs, unreachable branches, or unsupported legacy report shapes. Migrate assertions for still-supported behavior to the retained production boundary; do not remove security, byte-integrity, history, callback, or delivery-policy coverage merely because its old entry point disappears. Record the exact deleted tests and retained/migrated coverage in completion notes. This approval does not authorize unrelated behavior changes, dependency publication, commit/push, or final UX/E2E acceptance.

Implementation guidance
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/services/channels.md, and applicable naming/code-quality guidance. Read docs/documentation.md before updating stale API documentation. Recheck live callers and workspace changes before editing; review evidence was collected at f6a1d3070. No new Action or tool exposure is needed: this is local cleanup of existing Channel operations.

Validation and completion
Run focused affected existing suites and mix q per docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Preserve meaningful existing properties; introduce no tests that merely mirror private helpers. Report failures honestly, including unrelated known failures. Final coverage and mix precommit remain under zaq-1lw.13. This issue blocks architecture review zaq-1lw.12; sibling cleanups have no semantic dependency. Coordinate edits with other workers.
title: [zaq-1lw.26] Remove obsolete bulk attachment preparation API and migrate coverage
